purpose: Post-calibration correction of the market-independent M3 structural top-3 probability using pre-race career-history amount only. No odds/popularity/RPCI scenario correction.
universe: JRA flat, field_size>=12, 3-win class or higher; exact M3 validation universe (all runners in races with complete current-race PCI/RPCI/-3F fields).

protocol.development_selection: 5-fold GroupKFold by race. Compare M3 base probability with a logistic recalibrator using logit(M3 base probability) + prior_start_coverage10. C=0.1 fixed for regularized shrinkage.
protocol.race_coherence: After correction, apply one common logit shift within each race so probabilities sum to exactly 3.0.

feature_definitions.base_logit: logit of M3 structural top-3 probability after m3_top3_probability_v1 race-coherence projection
feature_definitions.prior_start_coverage10: min(number of strictly prior starts available for the horse, 10)/10. This is a predictive career-history amount feature, not a confidence score.

subgroup_monitoring.note: Global OOS improvement is significant in both years. Subgroup effects are not used to retune production thresholds.

2026_G3.action: monitor drift; do not create a post-hoc G3 exception without new future validation

runtime_guard.rule: Apply only when the uploaded history source demonstrably contains more than five strictly prior starts for at least one runner in the race; otherwise fall back to m3_top3_probability_v1.
runtime_guard.reason: The correction was validated with up to 10 prior starts. A truncated five-start export would make prior_start_coverage10 indistinguishable from a genuinely lightly raced horse.
runtime_guard.validation_status: operational safeguard, not part of the pristine OOS performance claim

naming: Use 履歴量補正, not 履歴信頼度補正. Lower or higher history amount can move probability either direction; it is a predictive covariate, not a monotone confidence score.
caveats: No odds or popularity are used.
No RPCI scenario correction is applied; that incremental correction was rejected separately.
This is not a betting signal and has no standalone ROI claim.
Do not introduce class-specific exceptions using the 2025-2026 OOS results without a new future holdout.
